name: qr-tools
title: QR Code
description: Generate real, scannable QR codes as Unicode block art directly in the chat via /qr slash commands — zero special permissions, fully offline, pure-JS implementation (byte mode, versions 1-25, Reed-Solomon ECC levels L/M/Q/H, optimal mask selection per the QR spec). /qr <text> encodes any text or URL; /qr wifi <ssid> | <password> [| WPA|WEP|nopass] builds a WIFI: payload phones understand. The chat renders the matrix with half-block characters that phone cameras scan straight off the screen.
